SELECT
  ii.product_category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN inventory_items ii ON oi.inventory_item_id = ii.id

  AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    SUM(sale_price) AS gross_revenue
  FROM order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)
),
monthly_with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    gross_revenue,
    LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, ROUND((gross_revenue - prev_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS increase
FROM monthly_with_lag
WHERE prev_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1

       COUNT(*) AS total_non_cancelled,
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_count,

WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND oi.status != 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:
WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.user_id, oi.order_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN jan_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status != 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at <= u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
),
user_order_counts AS (
    SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM non_cancelled_orders
    GROUP BY user_id
),
total_users AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM jan_users
),
users_with_two_plus AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_order_counts WHERE order_count >= 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((users_with_two_plus.cnt::numeric / total_users.cnt) * 100, 2) AS share_pct
FROM total_users, users_with_two_plus

WITH users_2024 AS (
  SELECT id, traffic_source
  FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
revenue_2024 AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND oi.status != 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users_2024)
  GROUP BY oi.user_id
)
SELECT u.traffic_source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count,
       SUM(COALESCE(r.revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(COALESCE(r.revenue, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS revenue_per_user
FROM users_2024 u
LEFT JOIN revenue_2024 r ON u.id = r.user_id
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY revenue_per_user DESC

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
FROM order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete'
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH user_acq AS (
  SELECT 
    id AS user_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS acq_month
  FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  ua.acq_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ua.user_id) AS user_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.sale_price), 0)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue
FROM user_acq ua
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.user_id = ua.user_id
  AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY ua.acq_month
ORDER BY ua.acq_month

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND oi.status != 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
),
day_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order_time - first_order_time)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS days_between
  FROM first_two
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM day_diffs

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT 
    id AS user_id, 
    TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS acq_month,
    created_at
  FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
converted_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id
  FROM user_months u
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.user_id
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND oi.status != 'Cancelled'
)
SELECT 
  u.acq_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cu.user_id) AS converted_users,
  ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT cu.user_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)) * 100, 2) AS share_pct
FROM user_months u
LEFT JOIN converted_users cu ON u.user_id = cu.user_id
GROUP BY u.acq_month
ORDER BY share_pct DESC

    FROM user_orders
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN order_time END) AS third_order_time
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn IN (2, 3)

)

    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
